method: Qualitative web search result review, one live Google Search sample in Lithuanian (hl=lt, gl=lt), clinic service inventory and official Google Search documentation. Not a controlled ranking or search-volume audit.

metrics.reason: No access to Keyword Planner, Search Console or paid keyword datasets. Priority reflects service relevance and user intent, not measured demand.

keyword_map.intent: Find a local clinic and clinician
Find a specific diagnostic service and preparation information
Arrange pregnancy confirmation and ongoing care
Discuss a contraceptive method with a clinician
Book a preventive check and understand screening questions

content_rules: Combine male/female and inflection variants in one service intent rather than duplicate pages.
Clinic service scope comes from the original site; competitor pages demonstrate vocabulary only.
No fake medical reviewer, ratings, qualifications, opening hours, prices or reimbursement claims.
No meta keywords tag, hidden keyword blocks or near-duplicate district landing pages.
Medical background sources appear on applicable service pages.

deferred_terms.reason: No confirmed price list. Existing service pages answer how to obtain prices; add actual approved pricing here when available.
Do not make unverified superiority, payment or referral claims.
Standalone midwifery intent differs from the existing physician obstetrician-gynaecologist service.
These procedures or locations are not established in the clinic service inventory.

measurement_next_steps: Verify the owned domain in Search Console and submit https://karpenko.lt/sitemap.xml.
After indexing and sufficient data, compare impressions, clicks, CTR and query/page pairs over comparable periods.
Use Lithuania-targeted Keyword Planner estimates if available; revisit priorities based on actual demand and conversions.
Publishing does not guarantee crawling, indexing, rich results or ranking.

observations: Results include ads, local clinic listings and organic provider pages.
G. Karpenko clinic appeared in the related local websites section of this single sample; this is not a stable ranking claim.
Related searches include price, reviews, referrals, urgent visits and other locations. Only verified clinic offerings should be targeted.

confirmed_clinic_positioning.fact: Private practice with a single clinician, G. Karpenko, who personally consults and performs examinations.
confirmed_clinic_positioning.copy_approach: Use the masthead to identify G. Karpenko. Keep body copy focused on services and patient questions; avoid repeated clinician names, staffing counts, and same-doctor slogans. Retain the practical telephone availability explanation.

female_clinician_intent_update.reason: User highlighted searches for a female clinician. Wording reflects the actual doctor; search frequency not independently measured.
female_clinician_intent_update.implementation: Homepage title and description, visible physician introduction, consultation title/H1/description and navigation label. Existing URLs retained.
